reuse.why: Threads the flag into the existing shouldSkipBulkBudget predicate that every month-wide action already calls, and drops the redundant hidden filter from the four SQL queries so the predicate decides it alone.

duplication.why: Adds no new logic copies; the four identical category queries and per-action loops that pre-date the change are left as they were.

placement.why: The hidden-category rule stays in the shared skip predicate in budget/actions.ts, with the flag on each action's argument object.

scope.why: Besides the feature, the diff reformats many unrelated existing test lines and type annotations (prettier wrapping), which inflates the change.

maintainability.why: One optional parameter on the shared predicate cleanly expresses the variation; the repeated flag plumbing across six actions and the formatting churn are minor costs.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions route the hidden decision through shouldSkipBulkBudget; the SQL bypass of the rule was removed.
